description: This source file implements a logging network change observer for monitoring network events such as IP address changes, connection type changes, network connections/disconnections, and default network changes. It interacts with the network change notifier and logs relevant events.

classes.name: LoggingNetworkChangeObserver
classes.description: A class that observes network changes and logs events related to IP address changes, connection type changes, network connections/disconnections, and default network changes.

methods.name: HumanReadableNetworkHandle
methods.description: Converts a network handle to a human-readable integer, with special handling for Android Marshmallow.

methods.name: NetworkSpecificNetLogParams
methods.description: Generates a dictionary of network-specific log parameters, including current network handle, type, default network, and active networks.

methods.name: NetLogNetworkSpecific
methods.description: Logs network-specific events to the provided NetLog.

methods.name: LoggingNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Constructor that registers the observer for various network change events.

methods.name: ~LoggingNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the observer from network change events.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when IP addresses change; logs the event.

methods.name: OnConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when connection type changes; logs the new type.

methods.name: OnNetworkChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when network state changes; logs the new state.

methods.name: OnNetworkConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a network connects; logs the event.

methods.name: OnNetworkDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a network disconnects; logs the event.

methods.name: OnNetworkSoonToDisconnect
methods.description: Callback invoked when a network is about to disconnect; logs the event.

methods.name: OnNetworkMadeDefault
methods.description: Callback invoked when a network is set as default; logs the event.
